entries.title: A warning before things grow worse
entries.odia: ଆଜ ହୁଁ ଏଡ଼େ, ପାଣି ପଡିଲେ ହବୁ କେଡ଼େ
entries.literal_meaning: Already this big; how big will you become when watered?
entries.explanation: An early fault prompts a warning about what unchecked growth could bring. It criticises present behaviour, not a child’s unchangeable nature.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏବେଠୁ ଏତେ ଦୋଷ ଦେଖାଗଲାଣି; ସୁଧାର ନହେଲେ ଆଗକୁ ଆହୁରି ବଢ଼ିପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: A tiny committee already imposes needless rules; someone wonders what it will do with greater power. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The water-and-growth image is figurative. The source presents this as a negative warning.

entries.title: Complaining while collecting
entries.literal_meaning: Keep crying; tie up whatever you receive.
entries.explanation: The complaint continues while the benefits are quietly gathered. Read as irony about dissatisfaction that does not prevent acceptance.
entries.meaning_odia: ମୁହଁରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଚାଲିଥାଏ, ତଥାପି ଯାହା ମିଳେ ତାହା ଗ୍ରହଣ କରାଯାଏ।
entries.usage_example: A guest calls every gift inadequate but carefully packs them all to take home. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Tying things into a bundle supplies the image. This interpretation is editorial; the witness provides no gloss.

entries.title: The name makes the difference
entries.odia: ଗଙ୍ଗା ବୋଇଲେ ଥିବି ଗାଙ୍ଗୀ ବୋଇଲେ ଯିବି
entries.literal_meaning: Call me Ganga and I will stay; call me Gangi and I will leave.
entries.explanation: A change in address changes the reception. The contrast can tease someone who insists on a particular form of respect.
entries.meaning_odia: ସମ୍ବୋଧନ ଟିକେ ବଦଳିଲେ ମାନ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯାଏ; ନିଜ ପସନ୍ଦର ଡାକକୁ ଏତେ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦେବାକୁ ଏଠି ଚିଡ଼ାଯାଉଛି।
entries.usage_example: An invited speaker accepts a formal introduction but objects to a familiar nickname. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Ganga and Gangi are retained as names; no real woman or originating incident is identified.

entries.title: The same choice after all that delay
entries.odia: ସେଇ ଘଇତା କଲୁ, ବୟସ ଗଡ଼େଇ ଦେଲୁ!
entries.literal_meaning: You married that same husband, after letting the years pass!
entries.explanation: After prolonged delay, the eventual choice is the one available before. The jibe targets the wasted interval.
entries.meaning_odia: ବହୁଦିନ ଗଡ଼ାଇ ଶେଷରେ ସେହି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଲେ; ଏତେ ବିଳମ୍ବ କରି କଣ ଲାଭ ହେଲା?
entries.usage_example: After months of indecision, a club adopts the venue it first considered. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Marriage supplies the wording. It need not be used to pressure anyone into marrying early.

entries.title: All that stamping over nothing
entries.odia: ତୁଛାକୁ ଏତେ ନା ମୁଦି ନାହିଁ ଗୋଡ଼ କଛାଡୁ କେତେ ।
entries.literal_meaning: Such a fuss over nothing: no ring, yet so much stamping of the feet.
entries.explanation: An exaggerated display outruns what there is to display. The source gloss connects it with being agitated over nothing.
entries.meaning_odia: ଦେଖାଇବାକୁ କିଛି ନଥିଲେ ବି ଅଯଥାରେ ଏତେ ଅଥୟ ହେବା ବା ଆଡ଼ମ୍ବର କରିବା।
entries.usage_example: A group celebrates a project so loudly that nobody notices it has not yet begun. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The witness does not specify the ring’s position or supply a story behind the image.

entries.title: Following another into a mistake
entries.literal_meaning: With the otter, the wildcat goes wild!
entries.explanation: Someone follows another’s lead into a mistake. The animal scene makes imitation look foolish.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣଙ୍କ ବୁଦ୍ଧିରେ ପଡ଼ି ନିଜେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଭୁଲ କରିବା।
entries.usage_example: One colleague starts an ill-judged prank; another joins without thinking through the consequences. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: Animal names are general renderings, not precise species identifications or claims about animal behaviour.

entries.title: Wisdom in consultation
entries.literal_meaning: At the gathering of the five is the Supreme Lord.
entries.explanation: The religious image gives weight to people deliberating together. It can encourage consultation rather than a decision made alone; it does not guarantee a group is right.
entries.meaning_odia: ମିଳିମିଶି ବିଚାର କରିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଏ; ଦଳ ଯାହା କହିବ ତାହା ସବୁବେଳେ ଠିକ୍ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Before changing a shared courtyard, neighbours sit together to hear one another’s needs. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary places this under five people gathered to discuss a subject. It is not the differently worded source127 position15.
